# Brainorth AI
> Custom-tailored autonomous AI agent solutions, production ML systems, and enterprise advisory.

## Overview
Brainorth builds production-grade intelligent systems for forward-thinking companies. We specialize in autonomous agent swarms, high-throughput machine learning pipelines, and sovereign VPC inference infrastructure.

## Core Capabilities
- Autonomous AI Agents: Multi-agent state machines, self-healing workflows, human-in-the-loop supervision.
- Machine Learning Systems: Hybrid vector RAG (pgvector), model distillation (LoRA, quantization), continuous evaluation benches.
- Deep Advisory & Audits: Architecture reviews, token cost containment, sovereign on-prem deployment.
- Hands-on Academy: 6 intensive training modules covering prompts, artifacts, tools, collaborative AI, and team reskilling.
